packageRules.description: One PR a month for all of cargo. `chore` keeps dependency bumps out of the release-plz changelog, which is generated from commit subjects.
Renovate cannot filter crates by rust-version (constraintsFiltering is python-only), so MSRV bumps must be a deliberate human change, not a side effect of a dependency PR.
Bumping nightly reformats the tree, so the Rustfmt job gates the PR rather than the diff being reviewable.
